bio.text: Clay Handy represents Idaho House District 27, Seat B, and lives in Burley; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a second term.
The legislature biography describes Handy as a fourth-generation Idahoan and Cassia County resident who served eight years on the Burley City Council and eight years as a Cassia County commissioner.
The biography also lists 13 years on the Cassia Regional Hospital board, including eight as chairman, and two terms as president of the Idaho Trucking Association.
